question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'appear'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• **appear - **seem; give the impression of being.
 
• **see - **perceive with the eyes; discern visually.
 
• **expose - **make (something) visible by uncovering it.
 
• **look - **direct one's gaze toward someone or something or in a specified direction.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would show the impression created by people with poor handwriting. 
 
• Hence, appear or option 1 is the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5. 

Correct passage__ - *Writing is a form (1) __of expression__, and neat handwriting is important when writing (2) __anything__ that will be read by someone else. We (3)__are often judged__ by the quality of our handwriting, and (4)__ when__ our handwriting is poor, we (5)__ appear__ to be lazy or incompetent.*
